name: Marek — 250 hours, flies every week, has run out of wing
summary: Mountain and cross-country pilot with well over 100 hours of thermic time, flying weekly, practising collapses and spirals regularly, and able to say plainly that his mid-B is now the limiting factor on most XC days. Instructor agrees he's ready.
why_this_persona: The clearly-ready case, and the one that proves every Ready-blocker at this step is clearable by an ordinary good pilot rather than only by a perfect one. He is deliberately NOT a full set of top answers: his ground-handling practice is occasional, his reading-the-day answer is the second-best, his descent options stop one short, and his season goal is a distance number. Ready should be reachable without a clean sheet.
